description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.6.2 (Host in supervisor), opi-fin.6.3 (ctx.host field), and opi-fin.5.x (stateful migrations) merged.

FILES:
- extensions/dynamic_tools.ex + test
- extensions/permission_gate.ex + test

For each extension:
1. Replace action fn-field calls (api.register_tool.(), api.get_active_tools.(), etc.) with Host client calls (Host.register_tool(ctx.host, tool), Host.get_active_tools(ctx.host)).
2. The host pid comes from ctx.host, available in every handler because Context carries it.
3. Remove API.bind_core usage for action fields in these extensions (the bind_core for exec or other non-action fields may remain if present -- check each extension).

TEST: Replace API.bind_core(api, %{action_fn: fn}) mock pattern with Host.Stub:
  {:ok, host} = Host.Stub.start_link(%{tools: [...]})
  ctx = Context.new(%{cwd: '/tmp', host: host})
  handler.(event, ctx)
  assert Host.Stub.calls(host) == [{:register_tool, tool_def}]

VERIFY: dynamic_tools.ex line ~21 captures api.register_tool as a closure. After migration this becomes Host.register_tool(ctx.host, tool_def) called inside the handler.
title: 6b: Migrate dynamic_tools and permission_gate to ctx.host
